notes.title: Localizations coming soon!
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaners and Queens of Tidy!

We're excited to announce the update of a new update for our hit game, "Cleaning Queens"! Get ready to shine and sparkle with the addition of support for 10 languages!

Soon, you can scrub, mop and polish your way through the game in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Polish. That's right, we are going global with our cleaning crew!

With our new update, you can tackle even more cleaning challenges and impress your friends across the globe with your sparkling skills. So, grab your mop and bucket and get ready to join the Cleaning Queens squad!

Remember, in the world of cleaning, teamwork makes the dream work! So invite your friends and family to join in on the fun, and let's show the world what we're made of!

Coming soon!

notes.title: New update is LIVE
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that a new update is now available for Cleaning Queens! This update includes several exciting new features and improvements that we hope will enhance your gaming experience.

We added 12 new levels and an additional story to your favorite cleaning game!

Also, we've added a brand new game mode hidden object alike, which challenges players to complete more difficult levels. We believe this mode will add a new level of excitement and competition to the game.

In addition to the new game mode, we've also made several improvements to the game's graphics and performance. You should notice smoother gameplay, faster loading times, and overall better performance.

Finally, we've also added Achievements, Wallpapers, and Music to the game's Extras, so be sure to check them out! 

We want to ensure that the game runs as smoothly as possible, and we appreciate your feedback and suggestions to help us achieve this goal.

Thank you for your continued support of Cleaning Queens, and we hope you enjoy the latest update!

Sincerely,
Brave Giant Team

notes.title: New levels - even more cleaning! Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h2]On your marks, get set, GO![/h2]

Gamers, get ready for an exciting new update that's about to take your gaming experience to the next level! We are excited to share that our most recent game update adds several new levels that will test even the most experienced gamers.

Our committed development team has been working hard to create fresh levels that are both enjoyable and challenging. We understand that our players crave fresh content and we are committed to delivering just that. The brand-new levels have been thoughtfully created to offer gamers a slightly different gameplay experience. We're looking forward to seeing how our players handle the fresh challenges!

But that's not all; we've also added several bug fixes and other enhancements to the game's general speed. We've listened to our players' feedback and implemented changes to make the game more enjoyable.

We encourage all players to take on the new challenges and let us know what they think. We always welcome feedback and suggestions as we continue to improve the game and deliver the best possible gaming experience.

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to dive into the new levels! We can't wait to see how far you clean.

notes.title: Cleaning Queens - Coming soon on Steam
notes.content:
Hi gaming people! 

We are proud & excited to announce this great news! 
Cleaning Queens is our freshest and polished game that came from our studio and is soon to be released on the Steam platform, that's clear (and soon to be clean!). 

What can you expect? 
A whole lot of cleaning actions, a bunch of tools to help you with that, and on top of that - renovation!

All you need for this cleaning is a comfy chair - sit back and relax, and things are going to become much better! 

Don't forget to add Cleaning Queens to your wishlist, more surprises waiting for you.
